rounds.response: For Alice: open your profile menu → Settings → Notifications and under activity on threads you participate in, turn off alerts for “All new comments” (or “Comments on threads you follow”) and keep only “Replies to you” and “Mentions” enabled. For Bob: try clearing Chrome’s cache, disabling extensions (especially adblockers), or using an Incognito window or another browser to rule out extension issues; also confirm the file type is supported (jpg/png/gif) and Chrome is up to date. If the upload still fails, open DevTools (Right-click → Inspect → Console/Network), copy any error text or screenshots, and post them here so we can escalate with logs. Let me know how those steps go and I’ll continue helping until it’s fixed.
